system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Ugh. Why has <USER> removed the ability to share a track directly with other users? Not everyone uses other social network/wants to integrate it, ! And what happened all the tracks friends sent me in my now-vanished Inbox? Significant degradation of the service 😠 <URL>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I totally get your frustration. For now, you can copy the Song Link and share it directly with your friends. Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Doesn't address the vanished Inbox issue."}
